comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (60.71%) to NRC-19 G: 21; H=L: 17%. GRAVY: 0.64; mol wt: 2509.962; mol formula: C114H181N33O29S1; mol ex coeff: 0. Activity: inactive against Gram- bacteria V.alginolyticus (MIC >200 ug/ml), V.anguillarum (MIC >200 ug/ml), V.brasiliensis (MIC >200 ug/ml), V.cholerae (MIC >200 ug/ml), V.fluvialis (MIC >200 ug/ml), V.harveyi (MIC >200 ug/ml), V.parahaemolyticus (MIC >200 ug/ml), V.plendidus (MIC >200 ug/ml), V.vulnificus (MIC >200 ug/ml), A.hydrophila (MIC >200 ug/ml), A.sobria (MIC >200 ug/ml), A.veronii (MIC >200 ug/ml), Gram+ S.aureus ATCC25923 or CMCC26003 (MIC >200 ug/ml), and N.asteroides (MIC >200 ug/ml). inhibited Micropterus salmoides rhabdovirus (MSRV), a major pathogen causing high mortality in farmed largemouth bass. Discovery: host expression:induced: bacteria infection increased the level in the skin, gill, spleen, head kidney, intestine. Updated 7/2025
title: A fish-specific antimicrobial peptide MsPiscidin2 inactivates MSRV and confers protection in largemouth bass.
